title: "Independent eQTL and DEG overlap summary"
## output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(here)
})
here::i_am('.git/HEAD')

## Genotype-wide dbSNP labels are cached from the RS-annotated genotype VCF
## in processed-data/00_genotypes/plink2/merged_maf05_variant_info.csv.gz.
## Plotting code should use that cache rather than GWAS-derived rsIDs.

repo_root <- here()
ref_dir <- here("processed-data", "ref")
plots_dir <- here("plots", "11_eQTL_coloc")

RUN_SEURAT <- TRUE
RUN_CUSTOM_CLUSTER <- FALSE
WRITE_DEG_VIEW_TABLES <- FALSE

source(here("code", "11_eQTL_coloc", "utils.R"), chdir = FALSE)

context_order <- names(SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID)
split_order <- "all"

analysis_configs <- list()
if (isTRUE(RUN_SEURAT)) {
  analysis_configs$seurat <- list(
    analysis = "seurat",
    tqtl_in_dir = here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "seurat", "tqtl_in"),
    tqtl_out_dir = here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "seurat", "tqtl_out"),
    tables_dir = here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "seurat", "tables"),
    deg_mode = "standard",
    context_order = context_order,
    split_order = split_order
  )
}
if (isTRUE(RUN_CUSTOM_CLUSTER)) {
  custom_config <- list(
    analysis = "custom_cluster",
    tqtl_in_dir = here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "custom_cluster", "tqtl_in"),
    tqtl_out_dir = here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "custom_cluster", "tqtl_out"),
    tables_dir = here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "custom_cluster", "tables"),
    deg_mode = "standard",
    context_order = names(CUSTOM_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID),
    split_order = c("all")
  )
  custom_manifest <- file.path(custom_config$tqtl_in_dir, "prep_manifest.csv")
  custom_outputs <- list.files(
    custom_config$tqtl_out_dir,
    pattern = "\\.gene\\.map_cis\\.tab\\.gz$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (file.exists(custom_manifest) && length(custom_outputs) > 0) {
    analysis_configs$custom_cluster <- custom_config
  }
}
if (length(analysis_configs) == 0) {
  stop("No eQTL analyses selected or available.")
}
```

```{r load-shared-inputs}
granges <- load_gene_ranges(repo_root = repo_root)
g2sym <- setNames(granges$gene_name, granges$gene_id)
sym2ensg <- setNames(granges$gene_id, granges$gene_name)

degs_by_mode <- list(standard = load_DEGs(repo_root = repo_root, mode = "standard"))

plink2_prefix <- here("processed-data", "00_genotypes", "plink2", "merged_maf05")
gwas_matched <- lapply(DEFAULT_GWAS_OVERLAP_DISORDERS, function(dis) {
  ## query broadly, then keep genome-wide significant genotype-matched variants.
  gwas <- loadGWAS(dis, 1e-6, repo_root = repo_root, si_min = 0.8)
  matched <- matchGwasGeno(gwas, plink2_prefix = plink2_prefix)
  missing_gwas_cols <- setdiff(c("variant_id", "p"), names(matched))
  if (length(missing_gwas_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing required ", dis, " GWAS columns: ", paste(missing_gwas_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  matched
})
names(gwas_matched) <- DEFAULT_GWAS_OVERLAP_DISORDERS

gwas_sets <- lapply(gwas_matched, function(dt) unique(dt[p < 5e-8 & !is.na(variant_id), variant_id]))
vapply(gwas_sets, length, integer(1))

analysis_manifests <- lapply(
  analysis_configs,
  function(config) load_eqtl_manifest(
    tqtl_in_dir = config$tqtl_in_dir,
    context_order = config$context_order,
    split_order = config$split_order
  )
)

lapply(analysis_manifests, function(x) x[, .N, by = .(split, covariate_model)])
```

```{r plotting-helpers}
eqtl_barchart <- function(mapsum, indep = FALSE, analysis_label = NULL,
                          context_order = names(SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID),
                          split_order = DEG_SPLITS) {
  dt <- copy(mapsum)
  dt[, context := factor(context, levels = context_order)]
  dt[, split := factor(split, levels = split_order)]
  if (all(gwas_count_cols(DEFAULT_GWAS_OVERLAP_DISORDERS) %in% names(dt))) {
    dt[, lab_above := sprintf(
      "SCZD: %d\nMDD: %d\nBPD: %d\nDEG: %d",
      n_SCZD_GWAS, n_MDD_GWAS, n_BPD_GWAS, n_DEG
    )]
  } else {
    dt[, lab_above := sprintf("SCZD GWAS: %d\nDEG: %d\nDEG+SCZD: %d", n_SCZD_GWAS, n_DEG, n_DEG_SCZD_GWAS)]
  }
  dt[, y_top := fifelse(n_eGenes > 0, n_eGenes, 0)]

  ytitle <- if (indep) {
    "Total independent cis-eQTL signals"
  } else {
    "eGenes discovered (lead cis-eQTLs, q < 0.05)"
  }
  title <- if (indep) {
    "Independent cis-eQTLs by context and split"
  } else {
    "Lead cis-eQTLs by context and split"
  }
  if (!is.null(analysis_label) && nzchar(analysis_label)) {
    title <- paste0(title, " (", analysis_label, ")")
  }

  ggplot(dt, aes(x = context, y = n_eGenes, fill = context)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(y = y_top, label = n_eGenes), vjust = -0.3,
              fontface = "bold", size = 3.1, color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(y = y_top, label = lab_above), vjust = -1.3,
              color = "black", size = 2.6, lineheight = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ split, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.32))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ytitle, title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80")
    )
}

deg_view_barchart <- function(view_summary, title,
                              context_order = names(SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID),
                              split_order = DEG_SPLITS) {
  dt <- copy(view_summary)
  dt[, context := factor(context, levels = context_order)]
  dt[, split := factor(split, levels = split_order)]
  dt[, deg_view_label := fifelse(deg_sex == "all", deg_view, paste(deg_view, deg_sex, sep = ": "))]

  ggplot(dt, aes(x = context, y = n_eGene_DEG_overlap, fill = context)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_eGene_DEG_overlap), vjust = -0.25, size = 2.5) +
    facet_grid(deg_view_label ~ split, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "eGene-DEG overlaps", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80")
    )
}

broad_eqtl_count_barchart <- function(mapsum, view_summary, deg_view, title, ytitle,
                                      context_order, split_order) {
  required_map_cols <- c("context", "split", "n_eGenes")
  required_view_cols <- c("context", "split", "deg_view", "deg_sex", "n_eGene_DEG_overlap")
  missing_map_cols <- setdiff(required_map_cols, names(mapsum))
  missing_view_cols <- setdiff(required_view_cols, names(view_summary))
  if (length(missing_map_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing broad plot map columns: ", paste(missing_map_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (length(missing_view_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing broad plot view columns: ", paste(missing_view_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dt <- copy(mapsum[, .(context, split, n_eGenes)])
  target_deg_view <- deg_view
  view_dt <- copy(
    view_summary[deg_view == target_deg_view & deg_sex == "all",
      .(context, split, n_eGene_DEG_overlap)
    ]
  )
  if (nrow(view_dt) == 0) {
    stop("No rows available for DEG view: ", deg_view)
  }

  dt <- merge(dt, view_dt, by = c("context", "split"), all.x = TRUE)
  dt[is.na(n_eGene_DEG_overlap), n_eGene_DEG_overlap := 0L]
  dt[, context := factor(context, levels = context_order)]
  dt[, split := factor(split, levels = split_order)]
  dt <- dt[!is.na(context) & !is.na(split)]
  dt[, lab_overlap := sprintf("DEG: %d", n_eGene_DEG_overlap)]
  max_count <- max(dt$n_eGenes, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_count) || max_count <= 0) {
    max_count <- 1
  }
  dt[, `:=`(
    y_deg = n_eGenes + max_count * 0.030,
    y_count = n_eGenes + max_count * 0.065
  )]
  y_max <- max(dt$y_count, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.03

  ## keep split colors stable across Seurat and custom-cluster plots
  split_colors <- c(all = "#707070", male = "#2B6CB0", female = "#C05621")
  split_colors <- split_colors[intersect(names(split_colors), split_order)]
  dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.78)

  ggplot(dt, aes(x = context, y = n_eGenes, fill = split)) +
    geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.72, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = y_count, label = n_eGenes),
      position = dodge,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 0.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 2.7,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = y_deg, label = lab_overlap),
      position = dodge,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 0.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 2.7,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = split_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ytitle, fill = "Split", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80")
    )
}

split_count_barchart <- function(mapsum, title, ytitle, context_order,
                                 split_order, count_col = "n_eGenes") {
  required_cols <- c("context", "split", "n_DEG", count_col)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(mapsum))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing split-count plot columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dt <- copy(mapsum)
  dt[, count_value := get(count_col)]
  dt[, context := factor(context, levels = context_order)]
  dt[, split := factor(split, levels = split_order)]
  dt <- dt[!is.na(context) & !is.na(split)]
  max_count <- max(dt$count_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_count) || max_count <= 0) {
    max_count <- 1
  }
  dt[, `:=`(
    deg_label = sprintf("DEG: %s", n_DEG),
    y_deg = count_value + max_count * 0.030,
    y_count = count_value + max_count * 0.065
  )]
  y_max <- max(dt$y_count, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.03

  ## use split colors consistently across output series.
  split_colors <- c(all = "#707070", male = "#2B6CB0", female = "#C05621")
  split_colors <- split_colors[intersect(names(split_colors), split_order)]
  multi_split <- length(split_order) > 1
  dodge <- position_dodge(width = if (multi_split) 0.78 else 0.65)
  bar_width <- if (multi_split) 0.72 else 0.58

  ggplot(dt, aes(x = context, y = count_value, fill = split)) +
    geom_col(
      position = dodge,
      width = bar_width,
      color = "grey30",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = y_count, label = count_value),
      position = dodge,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 0.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 2.7
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = y_deg, label = deg_label),
      position = dodge,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 0.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 2.7
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = split_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ytitle, fill = "Split", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 16, 8, 8)
    )
}

save_svg_plot <- function(plot, filename, width = 10, height = 6) {
  dir.create(plots_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plots_dir, filename),
    plot = plot,
    device = "svg",
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in"
  )
}

table_path <- function(config, filename) {
  file.path(config$tables_dir, filename)
}

write_analysis_tables <- function(result, config, write_deg_view_tables = FALSE) {
  dir.create(config$tables_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  fwrite(result$manifest_qc, table_path(config, "manifest_qc.csv"))
  fwrite(result$map_cis_summary, table_path(config, "map_cis_summary.csv"))
  fwrite(result$map_independent_summary, table_path(config, "map_independent_summary.csv"))
  fwrite(result$map_significant_summary, table_path(config, "map_significant_summary.csv"))
  fwrite(result$map_cis_significant, table_path(config, "map_cis_significant.csv.gz"))
  fwrite(result$map_independent_significant, table_path(config, "map_independent_significant.csv.gz"))
  fwrite(result$map_significant_unified, table_path(config, "map_significant_unified.csv.gz"))
  fwrite(result$map_significant_pairs, table_path(config, "map_significant_pairs.csv.gz"))

  if (isTRUE(write_deg_view_tables) && !is.null(result$deg_view_tables)) {
    fwrite(
      result$deg_view_tables$map_cis_deg_view_summary,
      table_path(config, "map_cis_deg_view_summary.csv")
    )
    fwrite(
      result$deg_view_tables$map_independent_deg_view_summary,
      table_path(config, "map_independent_deg_view_summary.csv")
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r summarize-analyses}
analysis_results <- lapply(names(analysis_configs), function(analysis_name) {
  config <- analysis_configs[[analysis_name]]
  summarize_eqtl_analysis(
    config = config,
    degs = degs_by_mode[[config$deg_mode]],
    g2sym = g2sym,
    gwas_sets = gwas_sets,
    repo_root = repo_root,
    include_deg_views = WRITE_DEG_VIEW_TABLES,
    context_order = config$context_order,
    split_order = config$split_order
  )
})
names(analysis_results) <- names(analysis_configs)

lapply(analysis_results, function(x) list(
  cis_rows = nrow(x$map_cis_significant),
  independent_rows = nrow(x$map_independent_significant)
))
```

```{r save-plots}
saved_plots <- unlist(lapply(names(analysis_results), function(analysis_name) {
  result <- analysis_results[[analysis_name]]
  config <- analysis_configs[[analysis_name]]
  plot_prefix <- gsub("_", "-", analysis_name)
  plot_width <- if (length(config$split_order) > 1) 15 else 10

  cis_plot <- split_count_barchart(
    result$map_cis_summary,
    title = paste("Lead cis-eQTL eGenes:", analysis_name),
    ytitle = "eGenes discovered (lead cis-eQTLs, q < 0.05)",
    context_order = config$context_order,
    split_order = config$split_order,
    count_col = "n_eGenes"
  )
  cis_file <- paste0(plot_prefix, "_lead-cis-eqtl-egene-counts.svg")
  save_svg_plot(cis_plot, cis_file, width = plot_width, height = 6.5)

  independent_count_col <- if ("n_independent_signals" %in% names(result$map_independent_summary)) {
    "n_independent_signals"
  } else {
    "n_eGenes"
  }
  independent_plot <- split_count_barchart(
    result$map_independent_summary,
    title = paste("Independent cis-eQTL signals:", analysis_name),
    ytitle = "Independent cis-eQTL signals",
    context_order = config$context_order,
    split_order = config$split_order,
    count_col = independent_count_col
  )
  independent_file <- paste0(plot_prefix, "_independent-cis-eqtl-signal-counts.svg")
  save_svg_plot(independent_plot, independent_file, width = plot_width, height = 6.5)

  file.path(plots_dir, c(cis_file, independent_file))
}))

saved_plots
```
